title: After AIDAMS
text: Graduation: gowns, a speech about 'the future', and parents crying in two languages. You hold an offer from your internship, a Master's brochure and a PhD supervisor's email that says 'no pressure'. What now?

hints: Mention the internship that produced the offer.
If flag pm_regular, PM shakes the player's hand on stage.

effects.text: You sign on a Tuesday. On Wednesday you buy a real coffee machine.

choices.label: Master's, one more year
choices.hint: A sharper toolkit, a later start

effects.text: One more year of cases, code and canteen pasta at the ESSEC–CentraleSupélec data science Master's. Your CV gets a second line in bold.
Three years, one thesis, 214 papers read and three that actually mattered. You are now Dr {name}.
A year rebuilding dry-stone walls in the Cévennes. Your hands are rough. Your head is quiet.

title: Your First Real Job
text: Offers land in your inbox, each with a salary, a mission statement and a photo of a beanbag. This is the big one: whoever you join, you'll slowly become a bit like them. Read the taglines carefully.

ai.tone: high stakes, satirical about corporate taglines
hints: Employers are fictional archetypes (defense analytics, oil major, bank, consulting, social media). Never name a real company.
Greyed offers show what earlier choices would have unlocked.
This choice sets the career path for years: make it feel heavy.
